title: Which club will win the 2026 Campeones Cup?
background: The Campeones Cup is an annual match between the previous season’s MLS Cup champion and the winner of Mexico’s Campeón de Campeones.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : The official competition result published by Major League Soccer, supported by reliable match reporting. 
  Resolution : Resolve to the club officially declared the winner of the 2026 Campeones Cup once the match has concluded, including extra time or a penalty shootout if required. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The winning club’s name.
